name: OmaScan
author: Guilherme Tiscoski
description: Scan a page from the bar with one click: a finished PDF in Documents or PNG in Pictures. Needs the OmaScan app.

barWidget.description: One click scans a page with your saved scanner and settings. Click again to cancel; right-click opens OmaScan.

schema.label: Save as
schema.description: PDF goes to Documents, PNG to Pictures. Saved choice is the one from `omascan setup`.

schema.label: OmaScan command
schema.description: Only needed for a build outside PATH, e.g. ~/omascan/build/omascan.
